title: The Inactive tab uses the same order as the Active tab
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has switched off two standard Net terms and one term of its own, and you check their order on the Inactive tab.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 60, Net 7 and the shop's own {Term-A}, due on day 5 of the following month, are deactivated.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-04 Fifth.
  • Other terms of the shop (from other tests) may also be listed; the checks below are about the order of the named rows.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: reading down the Inactive tab, Net 7 comes before Net 60, which comes before {Term-A}; the tab's count equals the number of rows on it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R5: “Rows are listed in this order on both tabs: COD; Due on Receipt; every Net term (standard and the shop's own) by number of days, lowest first; every "day of the following month" term by day, lowest first; any other term A to Z; Credit Hold last. Ties sort A to Z by name. The same order is used in every customer and vendor Credit Terms dropdown.”
  • S1-R14: “The Active tab lists every active term; the Inactive tab lists every deactivated term, standard and the shop's own, in the same columns and order.”
  • S1-R3: “Below the header are two tabs, "Active" and "Inactive", each followed by a count of the terms in it. The page opens on Active.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
